title: Recording screen with permission flow and live transcript
description: The screen where the user starts/stops a recording and watches the live transcript (goal 1).
steps: Create `ui/record/RecordViewModel.kt`: constructor `(controller: RecordingController)`; exposes `state = controller.state` and `fun formatElapsed(ms: Long): String` (mm:ss, or h:mm:ss ≥ 1 h) as a top-level function in the same file; `fun onNavigatedToSession() = controller.consumeCompleted()`.

Create `ui/record/RecordScreen.kt` (route `record`): top bar "New recording" with back arrow. Permissions: `rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions())` asking `RECORD_AUDIO` (+ `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` on API 33+). The Start button first checks `ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(RECORD_AUDIO)`; if not granted, launch the request; if denied show the text "Microphone permission is required to record." Notifications denial does not block recording.

Body: big elapsed time (`displayMedium`), phase text (LOADING: "Loading speech model…", STOPPING: "Finishing…"), a `LazyColumn` of `finalLines` that auto-scrolls to the last item when the list grows, and the partial text in italics with `onSurfaceVariant` color as the last item. Error text in error color when `state.error != null`. A large round FAB-style button: "Start" (mic icon) when IDLE, "Stop" when RECORDING, disabled otherwise.

When `state.lastCompletedSessionId` becomes non-null: navigate to `session/{id}` with `popUpTo("record") { inclusive = true }` and call `onNavigatedToSession()`. Until the session screen exists (TASK-17), register a placeholder composable for `session/{id}` in `AppNavHost` showing "Session <id>".

Home: add a `FloatingActionButton` "New recording" to `HomeScreen` that navigates to `record`, but if `modelStore.missing(ModelCatalog.requiredFor(language))` is not empty navigate to `setup` instead (compute in the click handler using the container).

material-icons-core has no Mic/Stop icons: add vector drawables `res/drawable/ic_mic.xml` (24dp, viewport 24, pathData `M12,14c1.66,0 2.99,-1.34 2.99,-3L15,5c0,-1.66 -1.34,-3 -3,-3S9,3.34 9,5v6c0,1.66 1.34,3 3,3zM17.3,11c0,3 -2.54,5.1 -5.3,5.1S6.7,14 6.7,11L5,11c0,3.41 2.72,6.23 6,6.72L11,21h2v-3.28c3.28,-0.48 6,-3.3 6,-6.72h-1.7z`, fillColor `#FF000000`) and `res/drawable/ic_stop.xml` (pathData `M6,6h12v12H6z`), used with `painterResource`. For back arrows use `Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack`.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation route `record` exists and is reachable from the home FAB (visible in `AppNavHost.kt` and `HomeScreen.kt`)
The Start button path requests RECORD_AUDIO before starting the service (visible in `RecordScreen.kt`)
